inv.desc_es:
Calle Áncora esquina Calle Jalón · A pasos del Paseo Marítimo Antonio Banderas

¿Buscas un negocio a un paso de la playa? Este local lo tiene todo.

Está en una esquina a metros del mar y del paseo marítimo Antonio Banderas, y justo delante están las torres nuevas. Es una zona excelente para trabajar con residentes y estudiantes, tanto con comida en el local como con entrega a domicilio.

Un negocio con doble turno
De día: puedes ofrecer pescado frito, tan de la zona y tan fácil de vender.
De noche: puedes ofrecer camperos y comida informal para quien sale a cenar o pide a casa.

inv.desc_en:
Áncora Street at the corner of Jalón Street · Just steps from the Antonio Banderas Boardwalk

Looking for a business right by the beach? This location has it all.

It’s on a corner just a few meters from the ocean and the Antonio Banderas Boardwalk, with the new towers right across the street. It’s an excellent area to serve residents and students, whether through dine-in or delivery.

A business with two shifts
During the day: you can serve fried fish—a local specialty that’s easy to sell.
At night: you can offer sandwiches and casual fare for those heading out for dinner or ordering in.

The Premises
Tables and chairs
Counter
High tables with stools
TV
Air conditioning

Equipment
Range hood
Griddle
Deep fryers
Freezers
Cash register
Microwave
Toaster
Dinnerware and kitchenware
And more equipment ready to go

Why It’s Worth a Visit
A lively neighborhood, close to the ocean and with the new towers right across the street
A fully equipped space, so you can get started without major investments
A day-and-night concept that adapts to your work style
